decisions.decision: Hand-edit the lockfile for the workspace link instead of npm install
decisions.why: npm 12 re-resolved Storybook's nested Vite and dropped 38 entries; the hand edit is 12 lines and npm ci accepts it

decisions.decision: Exports with a source condition for bundlers and compiled CommonJS dist for F5 and plain Node, typesVersions for node10
decisions.why: host tsconfig rootDir and node10 resolution; F5 runs tsc output and can only require JS

decisions.decision: Keep the renderer's ../signals import; core ships a plain holder and the extension aliases it to its signal
decisions.why: extension code stays identical so the normalized bundle diff is empty; the canvas stub disappears

decisions.decision: Zod schemas beside hand-written interfaces, held together by type tests
decisions.why: deriving 1,300 lines of types from schemas would change types across the extension at once
decisions.rejected: z.infer as the owner; Ajv on the JSON schema

decisions.decision: Scope at build time with PostCSS, prefixing selectors with :where(.sk-viewer)
decisions.why: zero added specificity keeps the cascade; the source stays readable
decisions.rejected: @scope (engine floor), nesting, a one-time source rewrite

decisions.decision: vscode.css keeps today's colours; role colours live in roles.css for light, dark and ap-ui
decisions.why: owner's delegate: extension unchanged, recolour stays a one-line switch

decisions.decision: Keep the extension's types byte-for-byte by making NavState and ExtensionToViewerMessage generic over the report payload and host state
decisions.why: the contract cannot import the extension's report pages; the host binds them in its shim

decisions.decision: Generate the VS Code theme from main's token files, inlining root-level values a theme block would otherwise change
decisions.why: the old cascade resolved some tokens on html; collapsing to one element changed them (the light scenario hue)
the old palette carried about 20 unused names

decisions.decision: Install banner stays in the extension and reads var(--sk-x, var(--x))
decisions.why: the spec editor imports it unscoped on the old tokens

decisions.decision: Canvas board aliases the old token names to --sk-* on body
decisions.why: its own UI read tokens the vendored viewer sheet used to set globally; V10 switches it properly

plan.summary: Package layout, runtime resolution, the signal seam, schemas and build-time scoping decided; V2 already proven byte-identical
plan.key_finding: The host tsc build cannot import package source (rootDir, node10, F5 runs tsc output), so the package needs a compiled CommonJS build beside its source exports

tasks.summary: 24 tasks: setup, foundational build wiring, three story phases (move, schemas and Node proof, styles), one validation task

implement.summary: speckit-viewer package with contract, core and styles; the extension, Storybook and canvas consume it; bundles byte-identical and computed styles unchanged

approach: Make packages/viewer a source-first workspace package with a compiled CommonJS fallback. Move the framework-free renderer, derivations and contract into it and leave re-exports in the extension. Move the CSS onto --sk-* tokens with four themes, scoped by a PostCSS build, and prove both moves with normalized bundle and computed-style diffs.
